correctness.rationale: For any fixed r, incidence unions yield a one-round log-avoidance error O_r(q^-2), accumulating to o(1) on the q log q terminal window. Mixed multitime survival factorial moments converge to those of PPP(e^-x dx). Pairwise avoidance has b-a^2=-q/v^2<0, giving exponential tails, uniform integrability, Gumbel mean and variance. Full subsets admit parallel exact estimates. Exact finite checker corroborates incidence identities and q=2 mean but is not an infinite proof.
